name: Wynaut
flavorText: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.
howToObtain: Breed from its evolution at the Solaceon Day Care or transfer via Pal Park

levelUp.name: Splash
levelUp.description: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

levelUp.name: Charm
levelUp.description: The user charmingly stares at the foe, making it less wary. The target’s Attack is sharply lowered.

levelUp.name: Encore
levelUp.description: The user compels the foe to keep using only the move it last used for three to seven turns.

levelUp.name: Counter
levelUp.description: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

levelUp.name: Mirror Coat
levelUp.description: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

levelUp.name: Safeguard
levelUp.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

levelUp.name: Destiny Bond
levelUp.description: When this move is used, if the user faints, the foe that landed the knockout hit also faints.
